summary:
Factory Manager changes required before approval:
1. render.rs Details quality Keep/Drop posts to /app/content-feedback and advances review; Details actions must preserve the current graded card.
2. Bridge copy promises an easier question will be asked first, but remediation members remain pending drafts until explicit keep/edit; make copy truthful until automatic scheduling exists.
3. ledger.css uses currentColor; configured Stylelint requires currentcolor.
4. design_preview Details checks only prove dossier strings occur after <details>, not before </details>; assert actual containment.
5. render.rs returns no Details when feedback is None, losing reference_text on revealed cards; render Details whenever any reflective content exists.
6. Required product proof is missing: real browser at 390x844 for graded-correct and graded-wrong, closed/open Details; inspect Continue remains visible and disclosure does not overflow or bury answer key. PR #138 review threads carry file/line evidence. Do not resolve or approve until code fixes and inspected artifacts exist.
